findings.title: Reflected XSS in Dalgona Challenge
findings.description: The 'name' parameter on /page is vulnerable to reflected Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). The application strips forward slashes from input but allows event handler attributes like 'onload' on SVG elements, enabling XSS execution.
